subject: allowing the user to save the file under any name s/he wants

messages.author: f912724b32d84d06
messages.subject: allowing the user to save the file under any name s/he wants
parts:
In my ui.r file I say, among other things:

    textInput("downIndividual","Save Individual Results:",value="Results Individual.csv"),
    downloadButton('downIndividual',"Save")

At the end of my server.r file I say:

  # Ensuring the user can save (download) the results:
  output$downIndividual <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste("Individual Results", Sys.Date(), ".csv",sep="") },
    content = function(file) {
      write.csv(bigone()$individual, file, row.names=F)
    }
  )

When the user wants to download the file s/he can change the name under which s/he wants to save the results. But it doesn't matter what s/he types - the results are always saved under this name: 'paste("Individual Results", Sys.Date(), ".csv",sep="") "
Why is it not allowing to download the file under any name s/he wants?

Thank you!
Dimitri

At the end of my server.r file I say:

# Ensuring the user can save (download) the results:
  output$downIndividual <- downloadHandler(
filename = function() { paste(input$userfilename, Sys.Date(), ".csv",sep="") },

content = function(file) {
      write.csv(bigone()$individual, file, row.names=F)
    }
  )

Thank you!

messages.subject: Re: allowing the user to save the file under any name s/he wants
parts:
Oh sorry, there's one input id and one output id, so you can use the same name.
But obviously you need to get the text input in downloadHandler.
